_about: The Archer's Stage 0 cards in the card Structure (book/cards/card-structure.md), decided with Lucas on 2026-11-16 (book/cards/archer-redesign.md). THE BOOK reads these in the place of the cards of the same name in ../archer.json; Foundry and the ruler still read ../archer.json until the Foundry pass. The trait key 'projectile' is the renamed 'shot'. Format: see ../stage0/paladin.json.

cards.name: Shifting Aim
cards.flavor: You never loose twice from the same spot: a step to the side, and the line is clean again.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [Ranged, Strike] Actions gain 1 Field Boon if you have left your square this turn since your last [Strike] Action (or since your turn began).

cards.name: Darting Blade
cards.flavor: You shift the bow to one hand, open a foe with the knife, and are gone before it turns.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Evade 2, then can stow the Light weapon you've drawn.

body.label: Special
body.text: You make this Strike with a Light weapon you hold.

cards.name: Quick Shots
cards.flavor: You loose arrow after arrow into one foe before the first has landed, and step away while it reels.

cards.name: Strafe
cards.flavor: You run across the line of fight and put an arrow into each foe you pass.

cards.name: Slip Away
cards.flavor: The moment a foe commits to reaching you, you are already somewhere else.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.

cards.name: Snap Shot
cards.flavor: A foe lunges for you, and you put an arrow in it before it has finished the step.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.

cards.name: Footwork
cards.flavor: You are never where you were a breath ago: a long sidestep, a run through the press, or a step with your hands already busy.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. During this Advance, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you, and you can move through the squares of unwilling creatures (you can't end in one).

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Evade 1, and before or after it you use the Interact or Reload Action (1A).

cards.name: Trick Shots
cards.flavor: You put the arrow where it will do something other than wound: through a cloak, past an ear, square on a shield.

cards.name: Spotter
cards.flavor: You read the field the way others read a page: where a foe hides, where the gap in its cover is, where you yourself are hardest to hit.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Your allies perceive the target one step better than they do: Hidden as Obscured, Obscured as Clear (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Your next [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn ignores the Banes of far and maximum range, and counts each target's Cover as one level lower.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Against each creature you have Cover from, your Cover is one level higher, up to High (1 round).

cards.name: Lean and Loose
cards.flavor: A wall is a quiver's best friend: you are out, the arrow is gone, and you are back.

cards.name: Blade and Bow
cards.flavor: Arrow, knife, arrow: each sets up the next.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on each of your turns, when you use a [Melee, Strike] Action after a [Ranged, Strike] Action, or a [Ranged, Strike] Action after a [Melee, Strike] Action, it gains 1 Boon.

cards.name: Thrill of the Kill
cards.flavor: One of yours drops, and your blood is up.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once an encounter, when an enemy you have damaged goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.

cards.name: Volley
cards.flavor: You send a flight of arrows high, and they come down on everything standing in one patch of ground.

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.flavor: You run the length of the fight with the knife out, opening every foe you pass, and somewhere along the way an arrow leaves your bow.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. After each square of this Advance, you hit each enemy adjacent to you that this Action hasn't hit yet with a [[Light]] weapon. Once, at any point of the Advance, you hit one creature within your bow's Range with your bow. You draw and stow the two weapons freely during this Action.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Weapon vs. Armor Defense. Roll once, when the first creature is hit: every hit of this Action uses that roll.

body.label: Special
body.text: [W] is the weapon that hit. The bow's hit is Doomed if you are Engaged when you make it.

cards.target: Each enemy adjacent to you at any point of the Advance, and one creature within your bow's Range

cards.name: Covering Fire
cards.flavor: You keep the arrows coming down on one stretch of ground, and nobody crosses it without paying.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 2 rounds, the Area is Difficult Terrain and [[Hazardous Terrain]] for enemies [HT: Entering, Turn, Movement]: [V] damage equal to 2 + your Weapon Modifier, of your weapon's subtype.

cards.name: Clear Lines
cards.flavor: Your friends have learned where not to stand, and you have learned to shoot past their ears.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your allies give your targets no Cover, and your [Ranged] Actions take no Field Bane for a target Engaged with one of your allies.

cards.name: Opening Shot
cards.flavor: Your arrow staggers the foe, and your ally's blade is already coming.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once a round, when you get a Tier 3 with a [Ranged, Strike] Action against a creature, one ally who threatens it can spend 1R to make a Weapon Attack (1A) against it.

cards.name: One More Arrow
cards.flavor: By now your hands move faster than you can think: there is always one more arrow in the air.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on each of your turns, a [Strike] Action of yours that deals [W] deals 1[W] more.

cards.name: Fleet
cards.flavor: Nothing on this field is as fast as you are now.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Each Evade of yours moves you 1 more square, and your Evades can enter Difficult Terrain.
